newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices steady to lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices steady to lower.

text.p: Millfeed prices were steady to lower on Friday with demand from feed mixers remaining light as most were content to buy only for immediate needs, millfeed dealers said.
"We just have nothing really new," a Buffalo dealer said. But he said demand in Ontario has supported the Buffalo market.
Pasture grazing continued to diminish the need for supplemental feeding.
"People are putting more livestock on grass in Kansas and Missouri," one dealer said.
In the Carolinas, spot prices weakened. "I think there is some extra supply around. Also flour mill run times have improved, hence the nearby weaknees," a North Carolina broker said.
Carolinas spot prices were offered at $86 a short ton, down $10. There was no bid.
